scripts.prebuild: npm run clean && mkdir out && cp -R img out
scripts.build-for-pdf: npm run prebuild && ecmarkup --verbose spec.html out/index.html --assets external --assets-dir out --printable --lint-spec --strict
scripts.pdf: npm run build-for-pdf && prince-books --script ./node_modules/ecmarkup/js/print.js out/index.html -o out/ECMA-404.pdf
